subject: Trove Green Provisions and Sustainable Retail
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Claire Flaherty about the launch of Trove Green Provisions, a low-waste refilling store in Medford. The discussion explored the store's mission to reduce plastic waste, its specialized recycling programs, and its philosophy of imperfect sustainability.

items.title: Listener Reactions to Supreme Court Draft Decision
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca shared community feedback regarding the leaked Supreme Court draft decision to overturn Roe v. Wade.

items.title: Introduction to Trove Green Provisions
items.summary: Claire Flaherty introduced her new eco-friendly and sustainable store opening on Boston Avenue in Medford.

items.title: Business Origins and Sustainability Philosophy
items.summary: Flaherty described her transition from a body care hobbyist to a business owner focused on reducing household chemicals and environmental impact.

items.title: Store Operations and Refill Station
items.summary: The store features a refilling station for laundry and personal care products where customers pay by the ounce to encourage container reuse.

items.title: Community Recycling Hub and Specialist Programs
items.summary: The shop serves as a hub for hard-to-recycle items, including soft plastics and shaving products, through partnerships with companies like TerraCycle.

items.title: Logistics, Sourcing, and Delivery Services
items.summary: Flaherty discussed her preference for sourcing from local and female-owned businesses and detailed a delivery model inspired by traditional milk deliveries.
